name: Devil's Gambit
source:
Devil's Gambit follows Hector, a badger healer returning to the little town of Rannai, the birthplace of his fondest memories. He holds dearly his time with the mischievous yet friendly wolves, the stories they told, the fertile forest east of town, and the mist that heralded every sunrise. Most of all, he remembers Cadgan: a wolf a bit younger and smaller than himself — an unrepentant troublemaker who left in him a bundle of emotions.

But that was nine years ago, when he was just a teenager. Upon his return, Hector finds the town transformed by the new duke's reign, and a Cadgan that has grown into a cold, distant mountain of a man. As he works as a healer and reignites a long-forgotten passion, Hector notices something other than love in the air.

The trees' roots stir with his every step.

Devil's Gambit is both a romance story and an unorthodox mystery. Both aspects are linked, and one wouldn't be a complete story without the other. Do you have the heart to unravel the secrets of Rannai's past and present? To get to the bottom of the phenomena affecting the town?

While Devil's Gambit will be a mostly linear experience, you can influence Hector at certain points of the story, possibly leading him to different outcomes for those events.

[From [url=https://roddio.itch.io/devils-gambit]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《魔鬼的策略》讲述了獾治疗师赫克托回到拉奈小镇的故事，这里是他最美好的回忆的诞生地。他非常珍惜与顽皮而友善的狼相处的时光，与它们讲述的故事，与城镇东部肥沃的森林，以及预示着每次日出的薄雾的时光。最重要的是，他记得卡德根：一只比自己年轻一点、体型小一点的狼——一个不思悔改的麻烦制造者，给他留下了一堆情感。

但那是九年前的事了，当时他还只是个十几岁的孩子。赫克托回来后，发现小镇因新公爵的统治而发生了变化，卡德根也长成了一座冰冷、遥远的山峰。当赫克托担任治疗师并重新燃起被遗忘已久的激情时，他注意到空气中除了爱情之外还有其他东西。

树根随着他的每一步而颤动。

《魔鬼的策略》既是一个浪漫故事，也是一个非正统的悬疑故事。这两方面是相互联系的，缺了另一方面就不是一个完整的故事。你有心解开兰奈过去和现在的秘密吗？想要弄清楚影响小镇的现象的真相吗？

虽然《魔鬼的策略》大部分是线性体验，但你可以在故事的某些时刻影响赫克托，可能会导致他在这些事件中产生不同的结果。
